paragraphs: R' Shammai. In R' Aha's name: Jerusalem Talmud, Demai, beginning of chapter 5. R' Avin said that R' Shammai said: end of Shekalim chapter 1. R' Bun in R' Shami's name: Ma'aserot 2:6. R' Ammi said that R' Shammai said: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot chapter 3, Mishnah 5. In R' Bun bar Hiyya's name: Shekalim, beginning of chapter 3. R' Shammai asked; R' Mana said, ‘It is fitting,’ etc. R' Shammai said: Shevi'it, end of chapter 3. R' Hiyya bar R' Bun and R' Yosi bar R' Bun in his name. R' Shammay: Ma'aserot, beginning of chapter 2.
